title: Unit – 3 : Session – 4 : SLO – 2  |  Stack Applications — Infix to Postfix Conversion
sections: I. Algorithm: Infix to Postfix Using a Stack
Step 1: Scan the infix expression from left to right.
Step 2: If the scanned symbol is an OPERAND, add it to the postfix expression.
Step 3: If the scanned symbol is '(', PUSH it onto the stack.
Step 4: If the scanned symbol is ')', POP and output all symbols until '(' is found; discard '('.
Step 5: If the scanned symbol is an OPERATOR:
a) If the stack is empty or top is '(', push the operator.
b) Else, pop all operators from the stack whose precedence is GREATER THAN OR EQUAL to
the scanned operator, output them, then push the scanned operator.
c) Note: '^' is right-associative — pop only operators of strictly higher precedence.
Step 6: Repeat Steps 1-5 until the entire infix expression is scanned.
Step 7: Pop and output all remaining operators from the stack.
Step 8: EXIT
II. Example: A + B * C -> ABC*+
Scan A -> output A. Stack: empty
Scan + -> push. Stack: +
Scan B -> output B. Output: AB
Scan * -> * has higher precedence than + -> push. Stack: + *
Scan C -> output C. Output: ABC
End -> pop * and +. Output: ABC*+
